place.title: Grotworm Lair
place.summary: For players wishing to kill the Queen Black Dragon or mature grotworms, there is a slide shortcut down to the bottom level of the lair, requiring 50 Agility. For players wishing to swim through the acid in the entrance, 50 Constitution is required.

Quetzathog.examine: As if hate could take form and stand before you.
drops: Only dropped if fewer than five ancient effigies are owned.

ml.name: The Shadow Reef
ml.text: Quetzathog is a miniboss in The Shadow Reef. It appears to be the unofficial leader of the sea horrors.

place.title: The Shadow Reef
place.summary: The dungeon contains achievements, 16 minibosses, and 3 bosses: The Crassian Leviathan, Taraket the Necromancer, and The Ambassador.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the Fremennik ship (Shadow reef)
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill)
• Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir on the bridge west of Al Kharid bank to sail to the Daemonheim coast
• Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir south of the Taverley lodestone to set sail to the Daemonheim coast
• Use a Shadow Reef teleport, which can be purchased from the Daemonheim Rewards shop
• Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Dragonkin Laboratory, the Temple of Aminishi, or The Zamorakian Undercity (requires completion of Impressing the Locals)
• Use the dungeoneering cape (requires level 99 dungeoneering) to teleport to Daemonheim woodcutting island dungeon (Key press | 5 ), then run north
pics: The ship to the Shadow Reef and the reward chest on the east coast of Daemonheim
